Issue_Reported: Cardiovascular personnel proceeded with Level 1, BR+0 Tilt test without a medical monitor present.
Description_of_Action_Taken: No comment.
Disposition_Comments: Test completion before the arrival of the medical monitor was due to oversight by the operators in part due to the BR +0 Tilt test commonly being performed as a block in series with Cardiac Function (ECHO), Vascular Function, and Plasma Volume, none of which require a medical monitor to be present in the room, as in Level 1 testing. Modifications have been implemented by the cardiovascular laboratory such as color coding testing procedure checklists to indicate medical monitoring levels. Additional changes have been implemented by FAP adding a "Medical Monitor Present" verification line to all Level 1 testing CRFs. The test operator will be required to obtain the CRF from the FARU Nursing staff and verify with the Integration Coordinator on Duty that the medical monitor is identified and present prior to starting Level 1 testing.
